test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 22 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Name the scheme initiated to protect elderly persons aged 60 years and above against a future fall in their interest income due to the uncertain market conditions.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Pradhan Mantri Vaya Vandana Yojana**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Pradhan Mantri Vaya Vandana Yojana (PMVVY) **is a Government of India-sponsored pension scheme for **older adults aged 60 and up**, which was available from** May 4, 2017, until March 31, 2020**.
 
• The plan has been extended for another three years beyond** March 31, 2020, to March 31, 2023**.
 
• The scheme offers an initial guaranteed rate of return of 7.40 percent per year for the years 2020-21, with the rate reset every year after that.
 
• The Scheme would give an assured monthly pension of 7.40 percent for the Financial Year 2021-22.
 
• This guaranteed rate of pension will be paid for the whole ten-year insurance period for all policies purchased until March 31, 2022.
 
• **After three policy years**, a loan facility is available. The maximum loan amount that can be given is 75% of the purchase price.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **The Atal Pension Yojana, formerly known as the Swavalamban Yojana**, is an Indian government-sponsored pension system aimed primarily at the informal sector. Finance Minister Arun Jaitley noted it in his Budget speech for 2015.
 
• **The Varishtha Pension Bima Yojana** was established to provide pension coverage to seniors over 55.
 
• **LIC Varishtha Pension Bima Yojana** is a government-sponsored senior citizen pension scheme administered by LIC.
